credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Doris Bry, Tish Frank, and Georgia O'Keeffe on the 'rank dank bank' getting ready to get in pontoons (old rubber amo carriers). This photograph is part of the album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Doris Bry, Tish Frank, and Georgia O'Keeffe Preparing to Load the Rafts
